description: Java class providing examples of using MockServerClient to match requests based on OpenAPI definitions, including loading OpenAPI specs from URLs, files, classpath, and literals, as well as updating expectations.

classes.name: OpenAPIRequestMatcherExamples
classes.description: Class demonstrating various ways to match requests using OpenAPI specifications with MockServerClient.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByHttpUrl
methods.description: Matches request loaded from an OpenAPI spec URL over HTTP.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPIOperation
methods.description: Matches request based on a specific OpenAPI operation ID loaded from URL.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByFileUrl
methods.description: Matches request loaded from an OpenAPI spec file URL.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByClasspathLocation
methods.description: Matches request loaded from an OpenAPI spec located in classpath.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByJsonStringLiteral
methods.description: Matches request using an OpenAPI spec provided as a JSON string literal.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPILoadedByYamlStringLiteral
methods.description: Matches request using an OpenAPI spec provided as a YAML string literal.

methods.name: matchRequestByOpenAPIOperationTwice
methods.description: Matches request with an OpenAPI spec loaded from classpath, expecting exactly two matches.

methods.name: updateExpectationById
methods.description: Updates an existing expectation with a specific OpenAPI operation ID.
